answer.answer: Amine-modified (aminated) polystyrene nanoplastics are the main polymer group reported with a positive median zeta potential, roughly around +5 mV in deionized/low-ionic-strength water. This figure is not robust: zeta potential is highly dependent on medium ionic strength, pH, and surface functionalization, and literature values vary widely across studies and conditions.
